final_steps.text: In season 1, Dottie, a bubbly newcomer from Iowa, moves into the Griffith Hotel. She introduces herself to Peggy and Angie and says the place seems like one big happy family.

In season 1, Dottie catches a gunman creeping toward Peggy's room at the Griffith Hotel, snaps his neck, and keeps his pistol. She hides the body under her bed and goes down to dinner as if nothing happened.

In season 1, a flashback shows young Dottie trained at a Soviet school for girl spies, where she kills her friend in a sparring match. Now in New York, she pockets Peggy's room key, searches her room, and takes a photo of Stark's stolen weapons.
final_steps.place: the L&L Automat and the Griffith Hotel, Manhattan (flashback: Soviet training school, Belarus)

final_steps.text: In season 1, a flashback shows Dottie stabbing a prisoner who refuses to join Leviathan. Now a Leviathan assassin, she kills a dentist to use his office for signaling Dr. Ivchenko, then knocks Peggy out with a drugged kiss at the Griffith Hotel and vanishes.
final_steps.place: a dentist's office across from the SSR, then the Griffith Hotel, Manhattan (flashback: Russia)

final_steps.text: In season 1, Dottie fights off Sousa at her sniper post, kills an SSR agent on her way out, and picks up Ivchenko after he slips out of the SSR. She hides a stolen Stark gas canister in a baby carriage, wheels it into a crowded cinema, sets it off, and locks the audience in.
final_steps.place: an office building across from the SSR, then a cinema, Manhattan

final_steps.text: In season 1, a flashback shows Dottie, as Ida Emke, charming Stark into showing her his hidden inventions. She helps Ivchenko kidnap Stark, then fights Peggy at Stark's hangar until Peggy kicks her through a window, and she slips away wounded.
final_steps.place: Howard Stark's hangar outside New York City

final_steps.text: In season 2, Dottie leads a bank robbery to steal a pin from a safe deposit box, but Peggy and the SSR are lying in wait and capture her. She mocks her questioners and gives up nothing, and FBI agents led by Vernon Masters take her away.
final_steps.place: the Bowery Savings Bank and the SSR office, Manhattan

final_steps.text: In season 2, Peggy breaks Dottie out of an FBI prison and sends her with Jarvis to a fundraiser to take a Zero Matter blood sample from Whitney Frost, which she does. She then sneaks off to spy on a secret Council meeting, and Thompson knocks her out and hands her over to Frost.
final_steps.place: an FBI prison, then the MacArthur Grand Hotel, Los Angeles

final_steps.text: In season 2, Dottie shrugs off Masters' truth serum, but Frost tortures her into revealing Wilkes, and her tracker is used to lure Peggy and Jarvis into a trap. After they all get free, Peggy locks her in the car trunk while they rush Jarvis's wounded wife, Ana, to a hospital, and there she breaks out and escapes.
final_steps.place: the Chadwick ranch, then Waverly Memorial Hospital, Los Angeles

changes.why: No source says the girl was her only friend; the flashback shows a new friendship with one girl (Anya), not that she had no others.

changes.what: 'Peggy locks her in a car trunk outside a hospital' -> 'Peggy locks her in the car trunk while they rush Jarvis's wounded wife, Ana, to a hospital, and there she breaks out'
changes.why: She is locked in the trunk before the drive, to make room as they rush the shot Ana to Waverly Memorial; she escapes after they get there. She was not locked in at the hospital.
changes.source: https://marvelcinematicuniverse.fandom.com/wiki/Dottie_Underwood ('Underwood was locked in the boot of the car as they rushed Ana to Waverly Memorial Hospital; however, once Carter had left with the Jarvis', Underwood was able to break free'); https://marvelcinematicuniverse.fandom.com/wiki/Monsters (Plot)

dropped.text: In season 2, Dottie appears only in Peggy's dream, dancing as a flamingo in a musical number while Peggy lies unconscious. In reality she is still on the run.
dropped.why: She appears only in Peggy's dream musical; by the rule, someone seen only in a vision or dream isn't there. The real Dottie is only mentioned in #17.
